quantity: Interpreted thickness of sediment above the last-glacial-maximum transgressive surface, meters
rights: USGS public domain with proper metadata and source attribution, per original FGDC use constraints.
limitations: Interpolated and manually edited from seismic-reflection profiles; 50 m pixels do not identify individual rocks or reef edges.
Thickness above an ancient transgressive surface is not current surficial substrate, water depth, fish presence or legal fishing access.
The original raster contains negative interpolation artifacts despite a 0 m minimum in its metadata; those cells are excluded.
